_about: Where home was, and when - build_trips.py calls a day 'away' when that day's photos/tracks reach more than AWAY_KM from the home in effect. Dates are inclusive ISO dates; use 9999-12-31 for 'still here'. With infer:true the exact spot is taken from your data (the most common overnight location near the point you give), so a town-level point is enough. Replace these examples with your own.

named_trips.name: Example thru-hike
named_trips.note: every away day in this span becomes one trip with this name

local_hikes: hikes on home days are grouped per home and year, e.g. 'Local hikes around Example Town, 2024'
